CustomField.description: GR-only meeting notes. Field-Level Security is granted solely by Gov_Relations_Custom_Object_Field_Access, so this field is invisible to every other team in the UI, in reports, in list views, in the API and in exports. Sensitive content belongs here; the standard Comments field remains the cross-team summary. Defined on Activity so it exists on Task and Event, but it is only placed on the Task layout.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: GR staff only. Nobody outside Government Relations can see this field anywhere - including reports and exports. Put the cross-team summary in Comments and anything sensitive here.
CustomField.label: GR Confidential Notes
